blogFaq.faqIntro: Thinking about starting a teeth whitening business? Here are the questions we hear most.

a: Cosmetic teeth whitening is an incredibly efficient method for enhancing the natural shade of your teeth, brightening them without the need to remove any of the enamel, the tooth's surface layer.

faqs.q: How Does the Training with Hollywood Whitening Work?
a: Our professional trainers conduct the training remotely, guiding you through every aspect you need to understand about our products.
They'll cover the legal requirements and also offer marketing guidance to help you succeed.

faqs.q: Is There a Demand for Teeth Whitening as a Business?
a: The demand for teeth whitening as a business is growing rapidly, as people are increasingly conscious of their oral health. The majority of people in the Western world suffer from some degree of tooth decay, so there is a considerable market for perfect teeth as well as teeth whitening products.

Several different methods can be used to lighten teeth, but laser teeth whitening is by far the most effective and safe. It uses light to oxidise the chemicals in the gel and break up surface stains on teeth. This method is usually instant and can be done in a lunch break.

faqs.q: Can a Non Dentist Own a Teeth Whitening Business?
a: Yes, non dentist can own a teeth whitening business. However, they will need to consult with Hollywood Whitening to make sure that the business complies with all the necessary regulations. In addition, they will also need to ensure that they have the appropriate equipment, products, training and guidance under the Hollywood Whitening Umbrella.

faqs.q: How Much is the Teeth Whitening Business Industry Worth?
a: The teeth whitening industry is worth an estimated $2.5 billion annually. This makes it one of the most lucrative and popular cosmetic industries in the world.

There are a variety of reasons why this industry is so popular. First, teeth whitening has become increasingly fashionable over the past few years, and people are keen to take advantage of any opportunity that offers a quick and easy solution to their tooth discolourations. Second, there is a growing awareness of the importance of good oral hygiene – especially among younger generations – and people are willing to go to great lengths to ensure that their teeth look their best.

In terms of pricing, teeth whitening treatments can range from very affordable to extremely expensive. However, people don't mind paying a little extra for Hollywood Whitening compared to others, which means our members are able to enjoy the popularity of using a great brand.

faqs.q: Does Laser/Light Teeth Whitening Weaken Teeth?
a: There is a lot of misunderstanding around laser teeth whitening and its potential effects on teeth and enamel. In short, while laser teeth whitening can cause temporary sensitivity, it does not weaken or damage the enamel in any way.

What actually happens during laser tooth whitening is that the light is directed onto the teeth, and the correct wavelength targets the whitening gel which causes an oxidisation to whiten teeth. This results in the removal of discolourations and surface stains from your teeth, in just 1 hour. While it may seem like your teeth are not responding well every time you go for treatment compared to the first, this is only because they are becoming more visibly lighter altogether.

faqs.q: What Foods Should One Avoid After Teeth Whitening?
a: After undergoing teeth whitening, it's advisable to steer clear of certain foods and beverages, including:
list: Foods and Drinks with Strong Colors (e.g. Red Wine)

faqs.q: How Do You Prepare Yourself for Laser Teeth Whitening?
a: There are a few things you can do to prepare for laser teeth whitening.
First, make sure that you brush your teeth prior. Alternatively, rinse with water before the procedure. This will help avoid any potential food getting in the way of the whitening process.
Secondly, make sure to wear eye goggles during the procedure.
